fields.name: login_identifier
fields.evidence: #27174 +0x3e-+0x5b reads captured route params; nullish params skip the property read at +0x55, not the own login_identifier assignment at +0x5b. The own key is always assigned, with undefined on the nullish branch or possibly from a missing params.login_identifier. JSON serialization may omit undefined; these instructions do not establish the downstream serializer or server omission constraints.

conditionalBranches: params == null -> login_identifier is assigned undefined; otherwise params.login_identifier is copied.
